name: Retsujou Aijou 01
source:
Everything was going fine until her husband's boss, Yamamoto, showed up unexpectedly. 
He knew her secret, and he used it to exploit what he demanded. Her body. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE097121.html]DLsite English[/url]]

他知道她的秘密，并利用它来满足他的要求。她的身体。
